reviews.text: We recently took our pup here for a UTI and the staff was so helpful and kind! Gabby P. was our vet tech and she’s always so amazing with our pup !!

This place is very gentle with your pets as if it was theirs they really care for them and make sure they are comfortable so that way they aren’t too nervous for their checkup. The staff is also very friendly like Dr.Sharp and Isabel. I would definitely make it a effort to bring my dogs here again

Tricia, thank you so much for the 5-star rating! ❤️🐾 Your support means the world to our team, and we're so grateful you've chosen to trust us with your fur babies! We look forward to seeing you again soon! 🐶💕 …

The only place I’ve been taking my pets for the last 9 years! They’re always treated with amazing care and Megan has made it so easy to get them scheduled, scheduled for follow ups, and with and prescriptions they have needed!
This is a great clinic that really cares for the fur patients. Megan is always super helpful in making sure we leave with all the information we need.

Wonderful experience! The staff is really friendly, caring, and professional. They truly care about the animals and make both pets and owners feel comfortable and welcomed. A special shoutout to Gabby P. for being such an amazing technician! She is knowledgeable, compassionate, and goes above and beyond to provide excellent care. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for quality pet care! 🐾❤️

My pets have been patients here for many years. First our poodle Chloe. Now our poodle Maggie. I absolutely love the doctors and techs and front desk staff. They have been so helpful and kind. Especially when one of my pets have been sick. They are very patient too. I ask alot of questions about my fur babies and they are always so kind and eager to help. Thank you to all of you. They were so compassionate when our Chloe passed away. And now help us with our new fur baby Maggie. ♥️🐶
Super great place great people very cost-effective and Britney is awesome

I am a first time customer and I took my baby here for her first check up. The staff was so nice! Even when I spoke to the lady on the phone, she answered all my questions and was super friendly. I’m glad I found a vet that I can take my baby to that makes me feel like a part of the family

I’m extremely disappointed with my experience at this veterinary practice. We originally came here because our longtime veterinarian retired and this office is conveniently located near our home. Unfortunately, the experience has been nothing like the care we were accustomed to.

I brought my dog in for what I expected to be a routine dental cleaning. He has had dental cleanings approximately every two years throughout his life. This visit ended up costing over $1,400, and eight teeth were removed. I was extremely uncomfortable with how the entire process was handled and did not feel there was adequate communication with me before such extensive dental work was performed.

Another frustration is the constant push for additional testing, labs, and medications. For example, obtaining refills for his heart medication requires laboratory testing that costs over $100, even when I have expressed that I do not want additional labs performed.

More recently, I brought my dog in for diarrhea and was sold probiotics that cost approximately $80. After only two days, he developed bleeding and I was instructed to stop giving them. Despite having just purchased the medication and being told to discontinue it, I was not offered a refund.

Communication is also a major problem. It often feels like you rarely have an opportunity to actually speak with the veterinarian. Most communication goes through the front-desk staff. One staff member has been very kind and helpful, but unfortunately I have found others unable to answer even basic questions about my dog’s care.

Everything also requires an appointment, and getting seen on short notice or as a walk-in has been extremely difficult.

This does not feel like the same type of locally focused veterinary practice we were accustomed to. My understanding is that the practice has changed ownership, and from a customer’s perspective, the focus now seems heavily centered around additional labs, medications, and charges. Veterinary care is expensive, and I understand that necessary testing and treatment cost money. My problem is paying significant amounts while feeling poorly informed and disconnected from the veterinarian actually treating my dog.

After spending this much money, I expect clear communication, transparency about recommendations and costs, and the opportunity to have meaningful conversations with the veterinarian. Unfortunately, that has not been my experience here, and I will be looking elsewhere for my dog’s veterinary care.

Will not be coming back to this clinic. Brought my dog in for UTI testing because she was showing symptoms and did not get results/medication for 4 days. After charging over $180 dollars to be seen, nothing was given prophylactally and their excuse was the doctor was out on Friday. There should be someone covering when these issues arise to run a clinic thoroughly and take care of patients appropriately. When I picked up my medication, the girl at the front desk with green hair was sighing loudly and slamming her mouse when I questioned their plan of care and medication treatment. Poor service and poor patient care. I will be looking elsewhere for my pets treatment. This place/staff are not it!

Excellent care and a wonderful staff! Everyone was kind, professional, and truly cared about our pets. They took the time to answer our questions and made us feel comfortable throughout the visit. Highly recommend!
Very friendly vets. Well informed and helpful.

We’ve been bringing Darla here since she was a puppy. Even though she’s very anxious, the staff is always patient and caring with her. So much love for the front desk ladies, they always answer every random question I have and never make me feel like I’m asking too much.

We have been going here for over a year and unfortunately the service and care has gone downhill. There were several expired pet vaccines that went unnoticed because “their system had a glitch.” We received the wrong dosage of medication for our pet because of a mathematical error. I had to go back to the vet in order to receive the correct dosage. I do not feel like I should have to monitor or keep up with the vet and project manage them to do their job. We will be taking our dogs to a more caring facility with better attention to detail.

A friend recommended Animal Hospital of Westover Hills many years ago when we needed a second opinion. We've taken all our animals there since, probably around 20+ years now. Dr. Sharp is very knowledgeable and figured out our cats skin issue when the emergency vet didn't. They take your animals care seriously.
I like the Veterinarian & the staff. They are all very very good with my dog.

These people were very kind, they did not run unnecessary tests or price gouge me. Vets prices have increase exponentially accross the bored so I can't say it was cheap and unfortunately my fur baby was to ill to heel and I had to make the excruciating decision to put her to sleep and end her pain, they gave me all the time I needed and when I was ready the Vet Tech took me home and even bought me a pizza, knowing how devastated I was I probably wouldn't have eaten otherwise. She deserves a raise. Thanks to all involved 🙌

I got a new puppy and wanted to get him checked out. Staff was super friendly and extremely knowledgeable. Definitely my puppies vet for life. Thanks for being so caring. We've been coming here for over 4 years and our family has grown.  Everyone here is the most caring people i have ever met.you can tell its a passion for them and not a job. The doctors always want what's best for the pets health and are amazing with them. Its funny how happy my boston terriers are going to the vet. Never thought id see anything like that

Dr Sharp has been our vet for almost 2 decades.  We have tried vets closer to us but have cone to conclude he is a truly caring vet.  We drive across from Timberwood to Westover Hills, because we feel incredibly safe that he truly cares.  Thank you Dr. Sharp.
They treated me with respect and sympathy when I had to put my 19 yr old cat down. They allowed me all the time I needed to say goodbye and provided me information for grief counseling services.

Been going here for yrs. Dr. Sharp isn't alot of fluff... which I like.... I'm there for him to take care of my animals. No complaints and have been happy with the service.  Staff are great!! Very personable.

I visited this vet yesterday because our family pet kitty Gabby is ill. The whole staff was welcoming and kind, however there was one staff member that was exceptional. Casey (Kasey) detected that I was having trouble with my back and helped me carry Gabby to the exam room and then even out to my car at the end of my visit. That level of understanding and caring speaks volumes. Thank you for everything!

Absolutely wonderful.  That took care of Boo. He had surgery and all the staff we professional, kind, caring,and knowledgeable. The Dr. did a fantastic job finding the foreign object in Boo's stomach. He's doing absolutely wonderful . I will be forever thankful to them.
Dr. Sharp is very knowledgeable and my dog enjoys the calming atmosphere.

Been going there for years now , staff is always very friendly and quick to take action
Sara and Lorenzo are great .👍👍 …
I would highly recommend this place. They are caring and welcoming.  Very thorough.
Doctor Sharp is very sharp, good vet to deal with

We’ve been bringing our dogs—Sadie, Scottie, and Luna—to Animal Hospital of Westover Hills for the past two years, and we’ve had nothing but wonderful experiences. The entire team is always so friendly, kind, and professional. They truly care about each pet that walks through their doors. Sadie gets groomed by Lorenzo, and he does such an amazing job—she always comes home looking adorable! We’re so grateful to have found a vet we trust with all of our dogs. Highly recommend to any pet parent looking for a place that feels like family!

We have had the pleasure of bringing our two Yorkies to this hospital for over 17 years. We have watched the staff grow: mentally, spiritually, physically and financially. They have cared for and groomed both dogs in good seasons and bad seasons. I want to thank the whole staff for excellent experience and services throughout these many years. The greater community of San Antonio appreciate you.
Dr.  Sharp and staff are amazing. This is our second time using Animal Hospital of Westover. Friendly, clean and knowledgeable.

Animal Hospital of Westover Hills is wonderful! We take our two weenie dogs there for vet care and grooming. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, Dr. Sharp provides excellent care, and Lorenzo is an exceptional groomer.

I have been taking my pet here for years and always had great experiences. Staff is always friendly and helpful. The doctor & staff are knowledgeable and explain things well. They treat my pet very well. The groomer Lorenzo always does a great job with my dog!
They are very good with my dog and very convenient location from my house
I started taking my pets to Dr. Sharp more than 30 years ago.  He's very knowledgeable and has a terrific, friendly staff.
They are kind, polite and fast! the Vet Dr. is amazing and he knows what he is doing. He holds you accountable for your pet.

We had an unexpected injury with our dog while out of town over the weekend. After confirming with an emergency vet that it wasn’t urgent, we contacted Dr. Sharp’s office first thing Monday morning. His team was incredibly accommodating and fit us in between appointments without hesitation. Despite the full schedule, we never felt rushed. Dr. Sharp took the time to thoroughly examine, diagnose, and begin treatment right away. We left feeling confident and grateful excellent care from a team we trust.
Staff was all very kind and friendly, facility was clean and the Dr was very knowledgeable. We took in a stray we found and we plan to take in our other pets because we had a great experience.
Office is very professional and friendly!

Took cat in about a concern we had. Staff was friendly and there was no waiting. Dr. Sharp came in and explained what was happening but also what to look for. Explained everything so I didn't has any questions.  Purred during rabies shot so he was doing ok with people.  We found our vet.
Everyone made me and my pup feel at home. The vet techs did a great job.  The doctor is great and very informative.
Front desk receptionist is very unprofessional, rude and unhelpful. I would rather pay more and have my fur baby see someone else than have to deal with them.

This clinic came as a recommendation from a friend with high standards for their pets. This place is great. Clean clinic, professional staff and they didn’t price gouge me. Our vet was knowledgeable and took our concerns for our pup seriously. Give them a try if you’re on the fence

I will be using their services going forward. The office space is also spacious. You can walk your dog around for a bit before going inside.
